name: node
install_steps: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev cmake curl xz-utils python3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

curl -fLsS https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.11.0/node-v24.11.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/node.tar.xz && echo '46da9a098973ab7ba4fca76945581ecb2eaf468de347173897044382f10e0a0a  /tmp/node.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && mkdir /opt/node && tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /opt/node --strip-components=1 && for tool in node npm npx; do ln -s /opt/node/bin/$tool /usr/local/bin/$tool; done && rm /tmp/node.tar.xz

curl -fLsS https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm/-/pnpm-10.34.5.tgz -o /tmp/pnpm.tgz && echo 'ccb5c479cab1b00621325bfe7d4c9a8a8031e7a525d7249e275ecbec81b08db2  /tmp/pnpm.tgz' | sha256sum -c - && mkdir /opt/pnpm && tar -xzf /tmp/pnpm.tgz -C /opt/pnpm --strip-components=1 && ln -s /opt/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs /usr/local/bin/pnpm && ln -s /opt/pnpm/bin/pnpx.cjs /usr/local/bin/pnpx && rm /tmp/pnpm.tgz
